subject: Critical reviewer pairing and backfill: freeze-exception request
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Critical reviewer pairing and backfill: freeze-exception request

Hi Lauren / Markus —

We have an urgent coverage and performance-review fairness issue on Team Atlas I need to escalate. Two things happened this week: Sam Richards (L3 SRE) submitted a last-minute resignation (effective 10/23) and Priya (temporary coverage) just extended an unexpected medical leave through mid-November. That leaves a coverage hole across two critical reviewers for the upcoming Oct/Nov review cycle when we evaluate three mid-level ICs.

Why this matters: if we run reviews with single reviewers (or rotating temporary reviewers) we risk inconsistent calibration and a potential appeal case. Additionally, on-call capacity will drop below our 95th-percentile SLA for 3 weekdays/week during the month of November. The team is already on a reduced hiring cadence due to the freeze.

Proposal (short):
- Request a freeze-exception to open a backfill role for an L3 SRE (IC hiring profile) with a 12-week temp-to-perm clause.
- Pair reviewers for the Oct cycle (Markus + cross-team reviewer) to preserve calibration; I can nominate reviewers if approved.
- Interim: bring in one contractor (max $15k one-time) for immediate coverage through mid-Nov.

Required approvals / asks:
1) Lauren: provisional freeze-exception approval to kick off a targeted recruiter search and contractor procurement.
2) Markus: confirmation of reviewer pair nominations and role spec (I attached a draft role spec and a quick HC impact snapshot).
3) Monica: procurement & budget go/no-go for the $15k contractor.

Attachments: role_specification_sre_lead.pdf (draft), hc_impact_snapshot.xlsx

I can be available for a quick sync today if helpful. This is time-sensitive because Sam’s exit timeline starts ramping next week.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: hc_impact_snapshot.xlsx]

Irene — thank you for the clear write-up and the attachments. Can you confirm two quick items so I can green-light the exception:  

1) Impact metrics: please add the expected weekly severity-1 on-call hours lost (approx) and any customer-facing SLA exposures (if applicable). The HC snapshot you sent helps but I need a single-slide summary for exec review.
2) Succession notes: for calibration we need a short note on who the paired reviewer will be and why (previous cross-review history, domain overlap).

Assuming those two are provided by EOD Monday I'll provisionally approve a time-boxed exception (approval conditioned on recruiter brief and 12-week contractor cap). Monica — can you confirm procurement time-to-contract for a contractor up to $15k?

Also please add the quick HC plan link here so I can attach it to the approval request: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/HC/Oct-2026-HC-Plan

-Lauren

Adding the technical context and candidate reflex:

- Impact estimate: losing Sam reduces on-call capacity by ~18 hours/week at the 95th percentile (we currently schedule 3 people across weekdays; this would drop to 2 on some rotations). No immediate customer SLA breach expected but sustained risk for Nov if not addressed.
- Reviewer pairing suggestion: me (Markus) + Neha Kapoor (cross-team SRE lead; has reviewed with our team before and ran calibration last cycle). Neha is comfortable pairing on the three review packets.
- Candidate profile: L3 SRE with strong incident response and Python infra automation. ETA to offer if recruiter engaged: 4–6 weeks. If we approve contractor, Clara (TalentBridge) can supply a vetted 1099 within 7–10 business days.

I attached Sam’s one-pager on active projects and a CV for a recommended freelance candidate to speed procurement.

- Markus

Subject: Re: Critical reviewer pairing and backfill: freeze-exception request

All — thank you for the rapid updates and the numbers. After reviewing the HC snapshot and Markus’s risk estimate, I am provisionally approving a freeze-exception under these conditions:  

1) Timeboxed hire: post a single, targeted L3 SRE req with a 12-week temp-to-perm clause and highest recruiter priority. No additional headcount beyond the req until the Nov HC sync.
2) Contractor cap: Monica to proceed with procurement up to $15k for an immediate 1099; Clara’s TalentBridge candidate is acceptable. Monica, confirm vendor contract & PO by EOD Wed.
3) Reviewer pairing: Markus + Neha to pair on the three packets. Irene, add a two-sentence calibration rationale to each packet (copy Lauren) before distribution.
4) Exec notice: I’ll file the exception to the HC tracker (link below) and note the provisional approvals; final approval subject to the Nov HC sync.

Recording links & next steps: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1SAMPLEhcplan (HC slide)
Irene — please send me the one-slide impact and confirmation of the named reviewer by EOD tomorrow so I can finalize the exec note.

Approver: Lauren Bishop (provisional)
--
Lauren Bishop
VP, People Ops
Redwood Inference
